engine.notes: San Diego splits cleanly: Finest City for long form in Hillcrest, National Comedy Theatre for short form in Mission Hills and Mockingbird as the non-profit in Liberty Station; La Jolla's Comedy Store is stand-up, and Sidestage Improv's domain no longer resolves.

entries.name: Finest City Improv
entries.summary: San Diego's long-form theater and school at 3746 6th Avenue, with six class levels from The Joy of Improv to Create Your Show, electives, drop-ins, open jams and shows Thursday to Saturday.
entries.schedule: Shows Thu, Fri, Sat and some Sundays (21+); students choose start dates when registering
signals: Open jams on the show calendar
Shows three to four nights a week
entries.reasons: A venue of its own, shows most nights, the city's deepest curriculum and open jams; founding year and term dates are not on the pages read.

entries.name: National Comedy Theatre (NCT San Diego)
entries.summary: The competitive short-form theater at 3717 India Street, running since 1999 with more than 7,000 shows, MainStage matches every Friday and Saturday, a Sunday Company, house-team Thursdays and a three-level adult class track.
entries.schedule: MainStage Fri and Sat 7:30pm; Sunday Company 7:30pm; Level 1 next starts Tuesday October 20
signals: House teams first two Thursdays monthly
Classes for teens, seniors and autistic adults
entries.reasons: Twenty-seven years, its own theater, weekly shows with current dates and a three-level ladder; short form only.

entries.name: Mockingbird Improv
entries.summary: A non-profit improv theater and school at 2590 Truxtun Road in Liberty Station's arts district, teaching Improv Essentials core training, electives and youth classes, with a free intro workshop, open jams and shows like SmackDown Sunday.
entries.schedule: Shows and open jams listed on the site calendar; free intro workshop
entries.reasons: A permanent home in an arts district with classes, jams and shows, but no dates or founding year visible on the pages read.
